Raccoon Dog CR 1/4

This small fox-like creature has markings like a raccoon that you only see for a moment before it bounds away.

XP 100
N Tiny animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.; Climb 10 ft.
Melee bite +1 (1d3-1)

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Attack +0; CMB +0; CMD 9 (13 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Climb +11, Perception +8, Stealth +10, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Survival when tracking by scent

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a raccoon dog familiar gains a +2 bonus on Reflex saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forest
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These small creatures, sometimes call tanuki, are a close relative to foxes and other small canines. However, they bear markings similar to a raccoon and unlike other canines, they can climb trees fairly easily.
